lines.beaver: 민지 씨, 이번 달 업무 분담은 어떻게 돼요?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, how is the work divided this month?
lines.beaver_roman: minji ssi, ibeon dal eommu bundameun eotteoke dwaeyo?
lines.learner: 제가 사무 관리를 맡고, 지수 씨한테 회계를 맡겼어요.
lines.en: I'm handling office management, and I gave accounting to Jisu.
lines.roman: jega samu gwallireul matgo, jisu ssihante hoegyereul matgyeosseoyo.

lines.en: That's why I'll seat her next to me and teach her.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Did you tell the CEO?
lines.en: Yes, I told the CEO yesterday.

lines.beaver: 그런데 민지 씨는 승진은 언제 해요?
lines.beaver_en: By the way, when do you get promoted, Minji?
lines.beaver_roman: geureonde minji ssineun seungjineun eonje haeyo?
lines.learner: 다음 달에 승진 심사가 있어요. 합격하면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: There's a promotion review next month. I hope I pass.
lines.roman: daeum dare seungjin simsaga isseoyo. hapgyeokamyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.learner: 고마워요. 일이 조금만 적다면 더 잘할 텐데요.
lines.en: Thanks. If I had a bit less work, I'd do better.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. iri jogeumman jeokdamyeon deo jalhal tendeyo.

lines.beaver: 일이 많으면 업무를 좀 줄여 보세요.
lines.beaver_en: If you have too much, try cutting down your tasks.
lines.beaver_roman: iri maneumyeon eommureul jom juryeo boseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 사무소 업무 회의도 반으로 줄였어요.
lines.en: Yes, I cut the office work meetings in half too.
lines.roman: ne, samuso eommu hoeuido baneuro juryeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Nice. What about the team dinner? Is it this week?
lines.learner: 금요일에 해요. 동료들한테 실컷 사 주고 싶어요.
lines.en: It's Friday. I want to treat my colleagues as much as they like.
lines.roman: geumyoire haeyo. dongnyodeulhante silkeot sa jugo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 하하, 좋아요. 한때 회식 싫어하지 않았어요?
lines.beaver_en: Haha, great. Didn't you once hate team dinners?
lines.beaver_roman: haha, joayo. hanttae hoesik sireohaji anasseoyo?
lines.learner: 한때는 그랬죠. 지금은 동료들이 좋아서 괜찮아요.
lines.en: I did once. Now I like my colleagues, so it's fine.
lines.roman: hanttaeneun geuraetjyo. jigeumeun dongnyodeuri joaseo gwaenchanayo.

lines.beaver: 직장 생활에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Want to talk more about your work life?
lines.beaver_roman: jikjang saenghware daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 내후년쯤 팀을 관리한다면 정말 기쁠 거예요.
lines.en: If I manage a team in two years, I'll be really happy.
lines.roman: naehunyeonjjeum timeul gwallihandamyeon jeongmal gippeul geoyeyo.

lines.beaver: 꼭 그렇게 될 거예요. 금요일 회식 때 봐요!
lines.beaver_en: I'm sure it'll happen. See you at Friday's dinner!
lines.beaver_roman: kkok geureoke doel geoyeyo. geumyoil hoesik ttae bwayo!
lines.learner: 네, 준호 씨. 회식 때 봐요!
lines.en: Yes, Junho. See you at the dinner!
lines.roman: ne, junho ssi. hoesik ttae bwayo!
